Coastal lime kiln at Llanbadrig, Anglesey

Its original function was for burning limestone, from the adjacent quarry, the coal was imported by ship. The lime produced from this process was then spread on fields to enhance their productivity and counteract the naturally acidic soils of the area. The lime was also used for making lime mortar for building work.

name: Flagellazione di Piero della Francesca
description: La Flagellazione di Cristo di Piero della Francesca non è semplicemente un'opera d'arte, ma un vero e proprio manifesto scientifico. Il dipinto traduce in immagini i principi del trattato dell'artista, il De prospectiva pingendi, applicando allo spazio una precisione geometrica e matematica di livello ingegneristico.L'intera composizione è regolata dalla sezione aurea, che divide verticalmente la tavola in due parti proporzionali: lo spazio chiuso del portico a sinistra e la scena aperta con i tre personaggi a destra. Questa rigorosa armonia è supportata da una prospettiva a punto di fuga unico, in cui tutte le linee architettoniche del soffitto e del pavimento convergono verso un solo centro, posizionato all'altezza della cintola di Cristo.

name: Circuit de Spa-Francorchamps 1939 layout
description:
The Circuit de Spa-Francorchamps, utilized from 1921 to 1978, was a fearsome, 14.1-kilometer (8.76-mile) public-road triangle. Revered as one of the fastest and most dangerous racetracks in motorsport history, it featured legendary, high-speed sections like the Masta Kink and the Eau Rouge/Raidillon complex, before being replaced by a shorter modern layout.

Designed in 1920 by Jules de Thier and Henri Langlois Van Ophem, the circuit used everyday public roads between the Belgian towns of Francorchamps, Malmedy, and Stavelot.

As racing vehicles became faster, the layout was modified to increase average speeds. In 1939, the slow hairpin at Ancienne Douane was bypassed by a steep, sweeping uphill left-right-left combination, creating the legendary Raidillon. Following World War II and damage sustained during the Battle of the Bulge, the circuit was renovated in 1947, bypassing the Stavelot intersection to create a faster, banked corner.

![](https://i.redd.it/tqoxahc80f931.jpg)

name: 2002 Minardi PS02
description:
The Minardi PS02 was the car with which the Minardi team competed in the 2002 Formula One World Championship.

The PS02 was designed by technical director Gabriele Tredozi and chief aerodynamicist Loic Bigois, who had joined the team from the now defunct Prost team. The car was recognised as a significant step forward from the PS01, and the team utilised extensive wind tunnel testing in Italy and the United Kingdom. The car utilised the Minardi's unique titanium cased gearbox, and changed to a pushrod from pullrod suspension for the first time. The PS02 featured the new Asiatech AT02 V10 engine which would be dropped for the 2003 season in favour of Cosworth. The sidepod area design of the PS02 was quite similar to that of the Arrows A23.

The PS02 was launched in Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia in February 2002. Owing to support from the state tourism authority and lottery, Magnum. The shakedown took place at Imola Circuit, with Alex Yoong at the wheel.

name: Figure embodying "Gold"
description:
3D scan of a statue representing the metal “Gold”. An androgynous figure rises from the gold-bearing quartz crystal at the base of the caryatid. It presents a crown and a necklace with a pendant on a ceremonial cushion. Gold is thus depicted as the ‘King of Metals’ and a symbol of supreme worldly power.

The figure was created by Rudolf Weyr (1847-1914) and is part of the decorative program in Hall IV of the Natural History Museum Vienna.

**Object**: Gold– King of Metals (NHMW-DOC-00023)

**Collection**: Natural History Museum Vienna (contact: Stefanie Jovanović-Kruspel)

Find out more about the NHMW [here](http://www.nhm-wien.ac.at/en)

Scanned and edited by Anna Haider (NHMW)

name: REQUIEM
description:
Requiem  https://www.artstation.com/araghulijanyan
I'm happy to present my work titled “Requiem.”
The main goal in terms of meaning was to achieve a sense of generalization — but without slipping into abstraction. There are many details I reflected on, and I tried to make the sculpture look interesting from different angles, with symbolic weight not concentrated in a single spot. Still, the center of the whole composition — as the most perfect form, or perhaps an allegory of the Earth — is a small sphere held in the hand of a figure, or perhaps shown to us.
The sculpture was created in ZBrush, and rendered in KeyShot.
I designed the sculpture with the intent that it could be 3D printed or carved directly in stone. Of course, some additional technical adjustments may be needed for a real-world statue.
Overall, this work was a meaningful and valuable experience for me — one that I intend to develop further in future projects.
Thank you!

name: GöttwAIg – Wunderkammer(21) | 3D AI Skybox
description:
GöttwAIg – Wunderkammer(21). Barock digital | 3D AI Skybox Meta-Fiktion

Das Projekt transformiert die fragmentarisch überlieferte Wunderkammer des Stifts Göttweig mithilfe von KI in eine zeitgenössische digitale Form. Initiiert von Markus Wintersberger (FH St. Pölten) und Viola Rühse (UWK) in Kooperation mit Stift Göttweig, UWK, Neuhauser Kunstmühle und Verein DruckKunst entstehen digitale Neukreationen ausgewählter Objekte, begleitet von transdisziplinärer Forschung und unter Berücksichtigung von Nachhaltigkeit. Die von Abt Gottfried Bessel im 18. Jahrhundert geschaffene Sammlung wird nicht restauriert, sondern als Raum des Staunens neu interpretiert.

Universität für Weiterbildung Krems - Plattform für Nachhaltige Entwicklung
FH St. Pölten, Masterklasse Experimentelle Medien / IC\M/T
Verein DruckKunst – Verein zur Förderung und Verbreitung der bildenden Künste / Neuhauser Kunstmühle
Kunstsammlungen, Archiv & Bibliothek Benediktinerstift Göttweig

Kunst und Kultur im digitalen Raum – Call 2025

name: Figure embodying "Iron" - Mars ♂
description:
This 3D scan shows a bearded male figure, who represents the metal iron. He is holding a breastplate in his arms bearing the planetary symbol of Mars, the Roman god of war. In alchemical esotericism, Mars was associated with iron. Two morning stars hang from a chain in his right hand, and halberds and swords can be seen strapped behind his back.

The figure was created by Rudolf Weyr (1847-1914) and is part of the decorative program in Hall IV of the Natural History Museum Vienna.

**Object**:  Iron/Eisen (NHMW-DOC-00038)

**Collection**: Natural History Museum Vienna (contact: Stefanie Jovanović-Kruspel)

Find out more about the NHMW [here](http://www.nhm-wien.ac.at/en)

Scanned and edited by A. Haider (NHMW)

Scanner: Artec Leo. 

Contribution to the digitization project „Einsichten in die gesellschaftspolitische Dimension des NHMW über die Jahrhunderte von der Prägung des Wissenschafts-Verständnisses bis zum Nationalpark in der Lobau“ funded by the [BMWKMS](https://www.bmwkms.gv.at/).

description: Garby is a loud and stinky Stegarbasaur that once saved his fellow Dinotrux with a huge toot. He is laid-back, enjoys eating rocks and tends to gas off and produce bricks around others much to his friends' dismay. Until recently, he had never heard of a bath; he also once "ate some bad limestone" before he heard about Ty Rux and Revvit as "the weirdough T-Trux who teamed up with the oddball Reptool and took on D-Structs". He used to eat rocks with Goldtrux before his obsession with gold drove him mad; the mere sight of gold pieces and dust from the latter Stegarbasaur is enough to "give him the pebbles". name: Lasca retocada 2 - Cueva de Galindo 1
description:
Se trata de un instrumento sobre soporte de lasca. La presencia abudante de cortex en su cara dorsal permite identificar que la matria prima es una riolita de color café claro que fue obtenida de un canto rodado de río . Este último rasgo distingue a la tradición tecnológica expedita del sitio Cueva de Galindo, Cañón de Molino, Durango, de donde procede. El arte rupestre de este espacio ha sido ubicado como parte de la Tradición Pictórica del Arcaico (2000 a.C. - 600 d.C.). Esta clase de herramientas con un retoque unifacial, es decir, presenta en una sola de sus caras y en un borde únicamente, es muy característico de este contexto, sin que se haya podido documentar o inferir hasta ahora la producción de instrumentos bifaciales.

Más información: 
http://dx.doi.org/10.13140/RG.2.2.35225.53605

Proyecto: "Arte rupestre y paisajes culturales en el Durango prehispánico: estudio comparativo de dos antiguos humedales", aprobado por el consejo de arqueología

Elaboró: Dr. Daniel Herrera Maldonado.

description: Se trata de una puerta de madera de doble hoja, de color marrón oscuro (posiblemente caoba o similar). Las hojas de la puerta tienen inserciones superiores con cristales protegidos por una elaborada rejería metálica de color amarillo o dorado. El diseño de la rejería presenta formas curvas y ornamentadas con motivos de volutas, sugiriendo un estilo decorativo. La puerta está enmarcada por un entorno de piedra. La parte central, inmediatamente adyacente a la puerta, es de piedra de tono claro (beige o crema), con líneas de sillería horizontales y verticales bien definidas. La madera de la puerta presenta un relieve tallado con motivos vegetales o figurativos, particularmente notable en el centro y a la derecha de la puerta, junto a la manilla o pomo. La sillería de piedra a la derecha del marco tiene ventanas o nichos laterales con formas curvas y detallados relieves decorativos en la piedra.

name: Monastic Cell K2
description:
***Al-Rubaiat cells at Hosh Eissa*** are among the earliest landmarks of ***monasticism*** in Egypt, where the early fathers sought solitude and communion with God since the first centuries of Christianity. 
Their simple design reflects the spirit of asceticism, serving as places of prayer, meditation, and work, and standing as a living witness to the depth of the monastic heritage in the Beheira region.

It is called in Greek ***κελί*** and in Coptic ***katageion*** or ***xia***

***This Monastic Cell is located in Al-Rubaiat area in El-Beheira governorate, Egypt.***

This model is created from 2428 photographs (Nikon D5300) using Agisoft Metashape 2.2.1 Photographed in December 2023.

Thanks to my friend Mr: @Waleed.Nosair

name: Театр имени Наталии Сац в Алматы (до ремонта)
description:
РГКП «Государственный академический русский театр для детей и юношества имени Наталии Сац» — театр юного зрителя Алматы, дающий спектакли на русском языке.

Главным инициатором и первым руководителем театра стала театральный деятель Наталия Ильинична Сац, которая была в Алма-Ате в ссылке. 6 сентября 1944 года выходит постановление Совнаркома ЦК КП(б) Казахстана «Об организации в городе Алма-Ате театра юных зрителей». 7 ноября 1945 года театр представил алматинцам свои первые спектакли: утром шла «Красная Шапочка» Е. Шварца в постановке Н. И. Сац, а вечером — «Осада Лейдена» Исидора Штока в постановке драматурга и режиссёра Виктора Розова. При театре была создана театральная студия, в которой Наталья Ильинична Сац готовила театральные кадры. Постановки шли на русском языке. В 1946 году была основана казахская труппа. Первый спектакль на казахском языке «Золотой ключик» А. Толстого в постановке Н. Сац. Основной репертуар составляли произведения отечественных и зарубежных драматургов на русском языке.

name: ALEX BOYA WALKING BREAD TURBINE (1)
description:
This grotesquely whimsical 3D head is part of Walking Bread, an absurdist dystopian universe by filmmaker and illustrator Alex Boya. Sculpted as a polygonal .glb asset, the model depicts a lumpy, half-human, half-loaf form — a surreal bread zombie whose facial structure collapses between organic anatomy and baked crust. Its bulbous nose, asymmetrical ears, and cratered surface read like a post-apocalyptic pastry gone sentient.

The design emerges from Boya’s signature “genomic animation” aesthetic, where biology, industry, and the culinary collide into strange hybrid organisms. In Walking Bread, this head embodies themes of consumption, transformation, and absurd survival, drawing influence from body horror, Eastern European surrealism, and handmade sculpture traditions.

Optimized for real-time viewing in GLB format, this version features low-poly topology with subtle shading to capture depth and eerie presence. Ideal for integration into AR/VR scenes, game environments, or as an interactive exhibition piece

name: Tate Modern - weather project
description:
Olafur Eliasson's installation at Tate Modern
What it was: A large-scale, immersive art installation that occupied the Turbine Hall of the Tate Modern in London from 2003 to 2004.
Key components:
A large, semi-circular "sun" constructed from hundreds of mono-frequency lamps.
A ceiling covered in mirrors, which reflected the sun and the people below to create an illusion of a vast, infinite space.
An artificial mist that filled the room, creating a hazy and dreamlike atmosphere.
Purpose: To bring the outside world indoors and encourage viewers to think about their perception of nature, weather, and their environment. Eliasson also aimed to prompt reflection on themes like sustainability and urban disconnect from the natural world

name: Oxhead-Decorated Inscribed Bronze Li (牛头纹带盖伯矩鬲)
description:
Bronze Li Food Vessel Inscribed by Bo Ju with Oxhead Ornaments is a 3,000-year-old Western Zhou bronze food vessel. It stands 33.0 cm tall, 22.9 cm in diameter, and weighs 7,500 grams. Its design centers on vivid oxhead decorations: the lid knob is formed by two 3D calf heads facing opposite directions; the lid surface has raised oxhead motifs with upward-curving horns; the neck is patterned with six flat-angle thunder patterns; each of the three pouch-shaped feet displays an oxhead (horns protruding above the vessel surface). Made via piece-molding (body cast first, then decorations attached), the details are lifelike. A 15-character inscription appears on both the inner lid and neck wall: it records that Lord Yan granted Bo Ju cowries, so Bo Ju made this vessel to honor his father.

伯矩鬲是一件有 3000 年历史的西周青铜食器，通高 33.0 厘米、口径 22.9 厘米、重 7500 克，以生动的牛首装饰为核心：盖钮由两个相背的立体小牛首组成，盖面饰有角端上翘的浮雕牛首纹，颈部饰六条平角雷纹，三只袋状足各饰牛首纹且牛角上翘高于器表。器物采用分铸法制成，先铸器身再拼接附件，纹饰细节鲜活逼真。盖内与颈部内壁均铸有 15 字铭文，记载了燕侯赏赐伯矩贝币，伯矩因此铸器祭祀父亲的事迹。

name: Rahan Inscribed Cross Slab OF016-015003-
description: Early Christian cross-slab with inscription, recorded within Rahan graveyard (OF016-015002-) in 1913. It was described by Henry S. Crawford in 1916 as ‘the lower portion of a slab measuring 1ft. 6in. (0.45m) by 1ft. 6 in. (0.45m) incised with with a two line Latin cross surrounded by a single-line ring below which the shaft extends; across the stone are traces of a four lines of lettering’. In the fifth century Camelacus was appointed by Patrick to establish a monastery at Rahan (OF016-015005-), later re-founded by St Carthage in the sixth century. The monastery is contained within a large D-shaped enclosure with the Clodiagh River forming the straight section on its northern side. There are two churches inside the enclosure, of which the largest (OF016-015001-), dedicated to St Carthage, is still used as a place of worship by the Church of Ireland community. The second church (OF016-015005-) survives as a ruin in the care of the Office of Public Works. Slab stands in SE quadrant of graveyard.

name: Castillo Forga - Arequipa
description:
El **Castillo Forga**, ubicado en la ciudad de Mollendo, provincia de Islay, región Arequipa, Perú, es uno de los inmuebles más representativos del patrimonio arquitectónico de la ciudad. Emplazado sobre un promontorio frente al litoral, destaca por su singular arquitectura de carácter historicista, su volumetría y su estrecha relación con el paisaje costero de Mollendo.

Este modelo 3D busca contribuir a la documentación, conservación y difusión del patrimonio cultural, permitiendo explorar digitalmente las características arquitectónicas del inmueble y apreciar su valor histórico, urbano y paisajístico como parte de la identidad de Mollendo.

Patrimonio arquitectónico de Mollendo – Perú.

name: Young Woman of Amajac
description: This model is based on a sculpture of a woman from the Huastecaculture. The figure is depicted with a majestic bearing, an elaborate headdress, and richly detailed ornaments, suggesting that she belonged to the elite and may have been a ruler. Historical chronicles indicate that, in the absence of male heirs, women could assume power to preserve the continuity of the ruling lineage. This appears to have been the case in Tamazunchale ("place of the woman ruler") in the Huasteca region of present-day San Luis Potosí. The original sculpture is carved in stone and dates to between AD 1450 and 1521. It was digitized using photogrammetry by Artmonite in Madrid while on loan to the National Archaeological Museum for the 2026 exhibition dedicated to women in Indigenous Mexico. Download this model at: https://artmonite.com/en/product/joven-de-amajac/

name: Carved decorative pattern for CNC
description:
This model is designed for **CNC machines.**
The model is optimized for the "Subdivision Surface" modifier.

The ".blend" file has a patina effect configured using "Ambient Occlusion."

This 3D model was created as follows:
Initially, a sketch was drawn on paper.
Then, using wood chisels and gouges, the corner elements and the central (round) part (530 mm in diameter) were cut out by hand.
Then (with minor modifications) a 3D model was created.
The photo shows different variations of this wood carving, with minor modifications.
I am the original author of these particular patterns shown in the photo. However, there are already copies and imitations available online.

You can buy this model on FAB: https://fab.com/s/29c87ef66192

Historia dworu sięga 1421 kiedy to pojawiają się pierwsze pisane wzmianki o dworze przy rzece Prądnik. Dzisiejszy wygląd zawdzięczamy generalnym remoncie o charakterze ratunkowym z roku 1829, kiedy XVIII wieczną, barokową bryłę rozebrano i pozostawiono typowy architektonicznie szlachecki dworek. We dworze gościli między innymi: Jan Kochanowski, Mikołaj Rej, Tadeusz Kościuszko czy Olga Boznańska (która uwieczniła go na swoich obrazach). Swoją pracownię w jego wnętrzach miał wybitny malarz historyczny Jacek Malczewski.

name: 6 Nested Bonnet Torus Flux Networks | PAPP
description:
This model shows 6 nested flux wireframes generated from the high-k phase of a PAPP Bonnet torus visualization pipeline.

Each colored layer corresponds to a different k-fold symmetry value: k = 50, 100, 250, 500, 750, and 1000. The 6 flux structures are combined into a single OBJ scene as separate obj & distinct color to each layer for comparison.

The geometry comes from metric-resonance flux edges sampled on a 120 x 120 discretization of the underlying torus, giving each layer 14400 vertices and 30400 edge segments. The combined object contains 86400 vertices and 182400 line elements.

These flux networks are related to Bonnet-type torus deformations in an isothermic surface setting. The different k-values represent increasingly high-fold symmetric configurations, allowing to compare how the resonance structure changes as the symmetry order increases. The colors are intentionally non-physical and are used only to distinguish the 6 nested flux layers visually.

Paper & obj are on github /aconsciousfractal

name: Stylized Diorama of a Cozy Neighborhood
description:
This 3D model presents a charming, stylized diorama of a residential neighborhood block rendered in a high-fidelity voxel (3D pixel) art style. The asset features a cluster of nine unique houses arranged around a central cottage, emphasizing a cozy, simple aesthetic with sophisticated lighting and texture.

**Model Description**
This modular environment kit features a collection of suburban-style houses with a hand-painted feel. Each structure is meticulously crafted from voxels, creating a textured, tactile appearance reminiscent of classic sandbox games or tabletop miniatures.

The set includes a variety of gable-roofed homes, cottages, and small villas. Architectural details like chimneys, dormer windows, and recessed entryways are built directly into the voxel grid.

The houses are situated on a unified baseplate featuring paved sidewalks, grassy patches, and small shrubbery, making it ready for use as a level prop or a standalone isometric diorama.

name: A queda do céu e a mãe de todas as lutas - 2022
description: A obra aborda a luta dos povos indígenas e o amor pelo território, que é terra viva. Na pintura estão representados, além do céu e a terra, os encantos, os guardiões, as onças, as cobras grandes e muitos outros animais que também estão na floresta, desde as pequenas flores, as estrelas, o vento e o movimento das águas. A obra é inspirada no pensamento de duas lideranças indigenas. Um deles é Davi Kopenawa, autor do livro "A queda do céu", que trata de como a terra é um organismo vivo que sustenta o céu e toda a vida no planeta e, por isso, precisa estar saudável. A outra é Sônia Guajajara, que aforma que "a luta pela terra é a mãe de todas as lutas",  ressaltando o amor que move os povos indigenas a protegem o seu território e tudo o que nele existe. A tela aborda esse sentimento de pertencimento, do amor pela vida, de uma vida que se transforma. Ao mesmo tempo, a obra alerta sobre como a nossa sociedade de expliração e consumo coloca todo o ciclo do planeta em risco.

name: Carnasserie Castle, Kilmartin Glen
description:
Dating from the mid- to late-16th century, Carnasserie Castle stands on the summit of a ridge at the upper end of Kilmartin Glen. A a roofless ruin today, it was once a fashionable residence incorporating many of the latest Renaissance influences. It was the home of the first Protestant Bishop of the Isles, Master John Carswell, and its design is befitting of a man of his stature.

The castle is an accomplished piece of architecture, laid out as a single building integrating both a five-storey tower house and a hall range. Its masonry matched the design, with finely-carved features throughout.

From the parapets there’s a magnificent view down to Kilmartin Glen, which is home to a range of marked rocks, cairns and standing stones, some of which are visible from the tower.

To learn more about visiting, go to [our website](https://www.historicenvironment.scot/visit-a-place/places/carnasserie-castle/getting-here/).

Rae Project | [PIC058](https://canmore.org.uk/site/22835)

name: Atlantis_V2 | PAPP
description:
Atlantis V2 is a large-scale PAPP high-relief disc built as a Metatron Loka-style terraced ridge sculpture. 
The object encodes the concentric city of Poseidon through a dense radial architecture: 7 ring boundaries, 4 cardinal bridges, Poseidon’s trident, 12 family portal arches, the Protiktah/Chakana stepped cross, a central pyramid with twin obelisks, a caduceus-like double helix, 7 sacred rays, 24 orichalcum flame petals, 12 fortification towers, and 24 water-memory ripples. 
Generated from seed [169, 13, 12, 33], the mesh targets ~144,050 vertices and ~288,048 faces with Euler characteristic χ=2. 
The color system blends orichalcum gold, deep ocean blues, bronze, tin-grey, cyan, violet and ROYGBIV accents into a layered land/water city relief.

Generated by PAPP Framework.

name: Garibaldi Castle
description:
Garibaldi Castle is a sprawling medieval construction that dominates the small town of Khryashchevka, Samara. Construction began in 2006, aiming to bring a fairytale-esque vision to life. Though often mistaken for a historical relic, this is a modern structure designed to mimic the grandeur of Gothic castles, complete with exaggerated clichés the aesthetic could muster.

I initially set out to texture model the castle in full detail, but I lost motivation halfway through. Once I realized how incoherent and kitschy the design actually is, the charm wore off. It was still a fun exercise in modeling, and I figured I’d upload what I managed to complete.

name: Greek Inscription Mosaic, Church at Shiloh
description:
LiDAR-based 3D documentation of a mosaic floor fragment with Greek inscription from the Byzantine church at Tel Shiloh, now displayed at the Museum of the Good Samaritan, Holy Land.

The inscription reads: "Our Lord Jesus Christ have mercy on Shiloh and its inhabitants," serving as key archaeological evidence for the Byzantine identification of the site with biblical Shiloh. Two superimposed Byzantine churches (4th and 6th century CE) were excavated at Tel Shiloh, with mosaic floors bearing geometric patterns and Greek inscriptions. Before the first Temple, Shiloh was the central Israelite sanctuary, housing the Ark of the Covenant during the period of the Judges.

LiDAR scanning with Scaniverse (iPad Pro), processed for web delivery (109.4k triangles, 55.8k vertices).

Part of a practice documenting early Christian and Byzantine heritage sites in the Holy Land.

Museum of the Good Samaritan, Highway 1, Holy Land
Ref: en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Shiloh_(biblical_city)
📍 [](https://scaniver.se/L31.81636,35.35871)

name: Kissing Bug (P. howardi ♂) - Bejuco, Ecuador
description:
This male kissing bug (*Panstrongylus howardi*) was collected in Bejuco, Ecuador and 3D-scanned using [scAnt](https://sketchfab.com/3d-models/scant-open-source-3d-insect-scanner-234556e5bb714c30942f779ca582455e) by [EvoBiomech](https://sketchfab.com/EvoBiomech).

This insect is part of the [Infectious and Tropical Diseases Research Division](https://cisealpuce.edu.ec/en/research/research-groups/476-itd.html) collection at the [CISeAL](https://cisealpuce.edu.ec/en/) (Center for Research on Health in Latin America). This research complex studies tropical diseases in order to mitigate their effects and potentially eradicate them for good.

*Panstrongylus howardi* is an endemic species for Ecuador (restricted to the Manabi province) and a secondary vector of Chagas disease.

Reconstructed from 140 photos using RealityCapture 1.2 and further processed with Blender 3.3.1.

Scanned by: [Alvaro Lara](https://sketchfab.com/baru7279)

name: Ginkgo Wood Painted Case (宋银杏木彩绘四大天王像内函)
description:
The Ginkgo Wood Painted Case of the Four Heavenly Kings from the Song Dynasty is a precious artifact now housed in Suzhou Museum. It was discovered in 1978 in the third-floor heavenly palace of Suzhou’s Ruiguang Pagoda, originally used to contain the Pearl Pillar of the Buddhist Shrine. The case is made of ginkgo wood with a five-section nested structure.

The outer wall of the case features painted images of the Four Heavenly Kings. The artwork employs the “willow leaf” brush technique, creating fluid lines and vibrant colors. The kings’ facial expressions are exaggerated and lively, their images powerful and majestic. The small demons, some supporting with their heads and shoulders, others kneeling and carrying on their backs, further accentuate the grandeur of the Four Heavenly Kings.

宋银杏木彩绘四大天王像内函是一件珍贵的文物，现藏于苏州博物馆。它于1978年在苏州瑞光塔第三层天宫被发现，原用于安置真珠舍利宝幢。木函由银杏木制成，采用五节套叠式结构。

木函外壁绘有四大天王彩绘像。绘画运用柳叶描法，线条流畅富有变化，色彩鲜艳真实。天王面部表情夸张生动，形象威武，气势雄壮。小鬼有的头顶肩承，有的跪负背荷，更加烘托出四天王的雄伟之气。

Younger channel catfish are more consistently omnivorous, eating a large variety of plants and animals.

name: Zorats «Զորաց Տաճար» Սուրբ Ստեփանոս եկեղեցի
description: Зорац Тачар (в переводе «Храм Воинства» или «Церковь сил») — это уникальный памятник средневековой армянской архитектуры, представляющий собой единственную в Армении открытую воинскую церковь. Официальное название памятника — церковь Сурб Степанос. Храм был возведен в 1303 году по инициативе епископа Степаноса Орбеляна. У Зорац Тачар практически отсутствует закрытый внутренний зал. Алтарь расположен значительно выше обычного уровня земли. Храм строился специально для того, чтобы уходящие на войну конные полки могли принимать присягу, исповедоваться и получать благословение, не слезая с лошадей. Храм окружен древним оборонительным валом, средневековым кладбищем и множеством  хачкаров . «Զորաց Տաճար» (Սուրբ Ստեփանոս եկեղեցի): Այն կառուցվել է 1303 թվականին Սյունյաց մետրոպոլիտ Ստեփանոս Օրբելյանի կողմից: Սա Հայաստանում միակ պահպանված բացօթյա զինվորական եկեղեցին է: Տաճարը կառուցվել է հատուկ այնպես, որ մեկնող զորքը և հեծելազորը կարողանային պատարագ լսել, երդում տալ և օրհնություն ստանալ առանց ձիերից իջնելու:

name: Guildhall3D -- An Introduction
description:
Learn more on: 

📰 [The Spatial Heritage Review](https://nebulousflynn.substack.com/p/announcing-guildhall-3d-with-cradle)

🌐  [guildhall3d.com](https://guildhall3d.com/)

With a story spanning a thousand years, London’s Guildhall – one of Europe's finest surviving civic buildings – invites visitors to reflect on the grand sweep of history it has witnessed.

Now, Guildhall3D draws you into a high-resolution scan of the Great Hall, enlivened with 23 data points tracing this story back to Roman London. Digital scanning brings this past alive, celebrating military triumphs and the deeper achievements of peace.

Supported by the City of London Corporation, the team of historians and 3D scanners at Cradle of English has fashioned an intimate tour of this iconic building, bringing centuries of history to the world.

This is the third Guildhall to stand here, resilient through fire (1666) and war (1945), reminding us in its profound quiet that the human spirit endures.

name: William Gleeson (1833-45) Headstone
description: One of 162 headstones in Castletownarra graveyard (TN019-002002-), County Tipperary, recorded in 1982 by the Ormond Historical Society. 19th-century slate headstone marking the graves of William Gleeson (born c. 1833) who died in 1845 aged 23 years old. Erected by his father Michael Gleeson. Above the inscription there is an I H S Christogram and lozenge-filled Latin Cross with tree-of-life and INRI above all of which is contained within a foliate wreath with trumpering angel above. Flanked on either side by a ciborium/communion cup with an encircled crowing rooster on left side of cross with soul-effigy on either side of trupmeting angel. Noah’s Dove standing on an olive tree to the right of the cross. Faint traces of a tree-of-life rising above the Christogram on either ends. Crossbar of the H in the Christogram is lozenge-shaped.  Inscription framed within a border filled with V-shaped pattern/foliate decoration. Probably the work of the stonecutter Gunning of Killaloe, Co. Clare.

name: Lehariya Gate, City Palace of Jaipur, India
description:
LiDAR-based 3D documentation of the Lehariya Gate (Wave Gate) at Pritam Niwas Chowk, within the City Palace of Jaipur, Rajasthan, India.

Founded in the early 18th century by Maharaja Sawai Jai Singh II, the City Palace is a major example of Rajput architecture with Mughal influences. Pritam Niwas Chowk contains four ceremonial gates, each associated with a season and a Hindu deity; the Lehariya Gate represents the monsoon, distinguished by flowing wave motifs drawn from traditional Rajasthani lehariya textiles and painted architectural ornament.

Capture: LiDAR scanning with Scaniverse (iPad Pro), processed for web delivery (297.7k triangles, 149.4k vertices). Geometry and ornament preserved for documentation, architectural study, and digital conservation. Part of an ongoing practice documenting at-risk architectural ornament across Gujarat and Rajasthan.

Ref: (http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/City_Palace,_Jaipur)

📍 [Jaipur, Rajasthan, India](https://scaniver.se/L26.92669,75.82330)

name: Floriated Grave-Slab Fragment Rahan
description: Lower half of the top of a rectnagular grave-slab decorated with a segmented floriated cross-head in Rahan graveyard, in the townland of Rahan Demesne, Co. Offaly. This lower fragment of the floriated segmented-cross-head consists of one arm of the cross with shaft beneath and three horizontal lines between the top of the shaft and the cross head which represents the knop of the cross.  Four letters visible O B possibly contracted version of Obit and initials C B possibly the initials of the deceased originally buried beneath this graveslab. The arms of the cross terminate in a central bud with side leaves akin to the buds or leaves emerging from the branches of a tree in spring time, representing new growth and the renewal of life, a symbol of the resurrection through the death of Jesus on the Cross. The bud and leaves on the arms of the cross may also represent the cross as the lignum vitae, or Tree of Life.

name: Kultura3D - Synagogue, Borderland town, Biłgoraj
description:
The synagogue is a replica of the 17th-century wooden synagogue of Volpa, located in Belarus. The synagogue, built in 1648, was burned down by the Germans during World War II. The synagogue was reconstructed thanks to a detailed inventory conducted in the 1930s by Szymon Zajczyk at the initiative of Professor Oskar Sosnowski of the Warsaw University of Technology.

The synagogue of Volpa was called by experts the most magnificent in Europe. The ornate synagogue, built in a style known as Jewish Baroque, served as a model for such buildings. The initiative to recreate it is all the more valuable given that not a single wooden synagogue survived the war in Poland – all were burned down.

name: Steampunk House
description:
A massive steampunk house environment featuring two fully realized structures connected by a third-floor bridge, designed to feel both functional and chaotic in true industrial fashion. This project focuses heavily on dense detail work and layered storytelling through design.

The buildings are wrapped in an intricate network of pipes, pressure systems, and mechanical infrastructure, suggesting a self-sustaining energy system powered by boilers, steam flow, and experimental tech. Rooftops are packed with solar panels and exhaust systems, blending retro-futuristic engineering with a gritty, lived-in aesthetic.

Every surface was approached with intentional complexity, from overlapping materials, modular elements, and small mechanical details used to create visual depth and realism. From ventilation systems and scaffolding to interconnected pipework, the goal was to make the structure feel believable, functional, and constantly in motion.

I'd love to hear how you use this building!

name: Kissing Bug (T. carrioni ♀) - Loja, Ecuador
description:
This female kissing bug (*Triatoma carrioni*) was collected in Loja province, Ecuador and 3D-scanned using [scAnt](https://sketchfab.com/3d-models/scant-open-source-3d-insect-scanner-234556e5bb714c30942f779ca582455e) by [EvoBiomech](https://sketchfab.com/EvoBiomech).

This insect is part of the [Infectious and Tropical Diseases Research Division](https://cisealpuce.edu.ec/en/research/research-groups/476-itd.html) collection at the [CISeAL](https://cisealpuce.edu.ec/en/) (Center for Research on Health in Latin America). This research complex studies tropical diseases in order to mitigate their effects and potentially eradicate them for good.

*Triatoma carrioni* is a vector of Chagas disease in the south of Ecuador and in the north of Peru.

Reconstructed from 140 photos using RealityCapture 1.3 and further processed with Blender 3.3.1.

Scanned by: [Alvaro Lara](https://sketchfab.com/baru7279)

name: Molino del Miedo
description:
Torre molinar en ruina parcial. conocida como Castillico del Miedo. Situada en una loma al sur del monte Carmolí, a unos 12 metros s. n. m., en el campo de cartagena. Cronología probable entre los siglos XVIII y XIX. Declarado como Bien de Interés Cultural en 2007.

Volumen de cono truncado, diámetro exterior aproximado de 9 m. Muros de mampostería vernácula, con un grosor progresivo desde unos 2 metros en la base hasta 1 metro de espesor en la coronación. Carece de cubierta ni de maquinaria del antiguo uso como molino harinero, no tiene revocos ni acabados, tanto exteriores como interiores.

Al modelarlo se realiza un corte superior completamente horizontal, a cota 8,73 metros, para evitar artefactos por falta de cobertura fotográfica superior. Pese a ello reproduce con fidelidad proporciones, texturas y el estado de conservación actual.

name: Colonna Cattedrale di Santa Maria Assunta - Atri
description:
La terza colonna di destra della Cattedrale di Santa Maria Assunta di Atri (Teramo) conserva un ciclo di affreschi tra XIV e XV secolo, oggi perfettamente leggibili grazie al restauro.

Spicca la Madonna adorante il Bambino (1465) di Andrea De Litio, esempio raffinato di devozione rinascimentale locale. Accanto si trovano opere tardogotiche di scuola senese, come una elegante santa martire (forse Palazia) e una Madonna con Bambino attribuita al Maestro di Offida.

Di grande forza espressiva è il San Giovanni Battista di Antonio Martini, immerso in un paesaggio simbolico, mentre la scena con San Nicola e Santa Caterina d’Alessandria mostra influenze della pittura senese. Completa il ciclo un San Sebastiano della scuola del De Litio e un santo identificato tradizionalmente come Cristoforo.

name: relogio
description:
Relógio de pêndulo clássico em madeira, inspirado nos tradicionais “grandfather clocks”. A peça apresenta um corpo alto e elegante, com acabamento escuro e detalhes esculpidos que reforçam seu estilo vintage. O topo possui um frontão ornamentado, enquanto a estrutura é sustentada por colunas torneadas que emolduram a caixa principal.

O mostrador circular é destacado por um visor de vidro, revelando o pêndulo metálico e os pesos internos, elementos característicos desse tipo de relógio mecânico. Na parte inferior, outro detalhe circular dourado adiciona equilíbrio visual ao design.

Este modelo 3D foi desenvolvido com atenção à silhueta e aos elementos decorativos, sendo ideal para composições de cenas históricas, ambientes clássicos ou visualizações arquitetônicas. Inclui também controles e guias visuais do processo de modelagem, podendo ser útil tanto para apresentação quanto para estudo de estrutura e rigging em objetos estáticos.

name: Route 66 Fluorescent Hanging Light
description:
A 1960s style fluorescent hanging light modelled as a supporting prop for a personal Route 66 desert gas station environment project. Modelled in Autodesk Maya using high to low poly baking, UV mapped in Maya, and textured in Adobe Substance Painter using a PBR workflow.

Modelled from a non-orthographic reference image — a deliberate step forward from relying purely on blueprint references, developing confidence in reading form and proportion from real world photographic reference. Part of the same production pipeline as the hero gas pump asset — Maya modelling, high to low poly bake, Substance Painter texturing.

The light will feature in the final Route 66 gas station environment scene alongside the gas pump, station building, and surrounding desert props. Currently in active development.

Software: Autodesk Maya | Adobe Substance Painter | Unreal Engine 5

Unveiling "Solar Drive," a compact autonomous marvel resembling an RC car. At its zenith, four solar panels (3.7v each) harness the sun's bounty. Connected in series, they feed a voltage regulator, which meticulously charges two robust 18650 batteries. These batteries breathe life into a tailor-made Arduino, influenced by the Uno's design. Solar Drive's prowess doesn't stop at solar conversion. Equipped with a top-mounted lidar, it gauges distances on both flanks, employing a PID loop to maintain a central path. Delve deeper; with Solar Drive, you're glimpsing the future of sustainable autonomy! 🌟

name: Bell OH-58D Kiowa Warrior
description:
***hard-surface Modelling***

This project is a high-detail military helicopter created for real-time cinematic visualization and game-ready presentation. The focus was on achieving a balance between realistic hard-surface modeling, optimized topology, and cinematic lighting.

✦ **Modeling**
The helicopter was modeled using a hard-surface workflow with clean edge flow and optimized geometry. Special attention was given to the cockpit structure, rotor mechanics, landing skids, weapon systems, and aerodynamic body panels. The model includes both close-up cinematic details and efficient topology suitable for real-time rendering.

✦** Texturing**
Textures were created using a PBR workflow to achieve realistic surface response and material variation. Multiple layers of wear, dust, scratches, roughness variation, and subtle military paint damage were added to enhance realism. The decals, warning labels, and weathered metal surfaces help give the helicopter a battle-ready appearance.

name: Kilpeck Church South Door
description:
The south door draws attention first. It is alive with figures and foliage patterns. There are warriors, birds, snakes or dragons, monsters, and, near the top, an angel. The work is fluid, sophisticated and beautifully carved. The doorway is fantastically well preserved; until Victorian times it was protected by a porch. Now it is exposed to the weather, but monitored very carefully for signs of wear.

The church is small, built of red sandstone, and set on the edge of the village, with beautiful Herefordshire countryside stretching away on all sides.

The Church of St Mary and St David is a Church of England parish church at Kilpeck in the English county of Herefordshire, about 5 miles from the border with Monmouthshire, Wales. Pevsner describes Kilpeck as "one of the most perfect Norman churches in England".

Source: Wikipedia and National Churches Trust.

For more info visit www.preservia.co.uk

name: Monumento aos Herois da Guerra Peninsular
description:
O Monumento aos Heróis da Guerra Peninsular fica na Rotunda da Boavista, Porto, e homenageia os combatentes portugueses da Guerra Peninsular (1807-1814). Projetado por Marques da Silva e Alves de Sousa, foi inaugurado em 1952.

A estrutura inclui uma coluna de granito, encimada por um leão sobre uma águia, simbolizando a vitória luso-britânica sobre as tropas napoleónicas. A base contém esculturas em bronze com soldados e populares, retratando a resistência portuguesa. O monumento é um dos marcos icónicos da cidade.

O modelo 3D foi gerado por fotogrametria com imagens de drone e processado no Agisoft.

name: Secret of Evermore Teleport machine
description:
Fanart of my favorite SNES game ever.

This piece was fully sculpted in Adobe Medium inside VR.

Despite being largely discontinued, it still offers one of the most intuitive workflows I’ve used for 3D sculpting — especially compared to more complex, less beginner-friendly tools like ZBrush.
The project took about 2 days alongside a workshop I was teaching on the same topic. The same game also inspired the name of my VR animation studio: LAVAMACHINE.

Pipeline:
•	Sculpting in VR (Medium) 
•	Retopo / export (~1M polys) 
•	Texturing in Substance 3D Painter 
•	Lighting & rendering in Blender 

For me, VR sculpting remains one of the most direct and playful ways to explore form and spatial storytelling.

With a little more render magic here (Lighting & Particles and Fog  with Blender): https://youtu.be/SYO8GkB3xs8

If you're interested in XR workshops or immersive art workflows:
https://ericgiessmann.com/vr-workshops/

More of my work:
https://ericgiessmann.com/

name: Կուսանաց անապատ Кусанац Анапат (Пустынь Дев)
description:
Кусанац Анапат (Пустынь Дев) в Старом Шинуайре — это уникальный памятник, который был одним из немногих женских монастырей в средневековой Армении. Находится на северо-западной окраине Старого Шинуайра (Հին Շինուհայր), на склоне Воротанского ущелья. Церковь Сурб Аствацацин (1676 г.): Сердце монастыря. Это трехнефная базилика, построенная из грубо отесанного базальта. Помимо церкви, сохранились руины жилых помещений монахинь, трапезной и подсобных зданий. Весь комплекс обнесен стеной.
Կուսանաց անապատը (նաև՝ Շինուհայրի անապատ) Սյունիքի միջնադարյան ճարտարապետության և հոգևոր կյանքի ուշագրավ հուշարձաններից է։ Այն գտնվում է Հին Շինուհայր գյուղատեղիի արևմտյան մասում՝ Որոտանի կիրճի բարձրադիր լանջին։ Սուրբ Աստվածածին եկեղեցին կառուցվել է 1676 թվականին, սակայն տեղում եղել են ավելի հին հոգևոր կառույցներ (4-5-րդ դարեր)։ Սա եղել է կուսանոց-մենաստան, որտեղ ապրել և գործել են միանձնուհիներ։ Այն Սյունիքի սակավաթիվ կուսանաց անապատներից մեկն էր և սերտորեն կապված էր Տաթևի վանքի հետ։

name: Château de Loyat - Morbihan - France
description:
https://www.chateau-loyat.com/

"Témoin vivant d'un art de vivre, le château de Loyat a traversé 300 ans en gardant ses caractéristiques de grande maison noble du XVIIIe siècle.
Il nous renseigne sur l’organisation de cette époque et nous plonge dans le "Grand-Siècle".
Le château est construit entre 1718 et 1734 par l’architecte Olivier Delourme (1660-1729) pour René-Charles de Coëtlogon (1673-1734), vicomte de Loyat, en lieu et place d'un manoir menaçant ruine qu'il avait reçu en héritage à la mort de son père en 1704"

name: Darbas Церковь Сурб Степанос Սուրբ Ստեփանոս
description:
Дарбас — это живописное село в Сюникской области Армении, расположенное в регионе Сисиан в ущелье реки Воротан. Название «Дарбас» (Дарпас) в переводе с армянского означает «ворота». Согласно летописям, в XV веке Дарбас был крупным процветающим поселением, в котором насчитывалось 7 церквей и около 700 семей. на сегодня в селе Дарбас находятся два известных религиозных объекта, представляющих разные эпохи: Церковь Сурб Степанос (Святого Стефана) - построенная в 2010 году и руины церкви Сурб Аствацацин (Святой Богородицы), возведеная в XIII веке.
Սյունիքի մարզի Դարբաս գյուղի Սուրբ Ստեփանոս եկեղեցին ժամանակակից հայկական եկեղեցաշինության վառ օրինակներից է: Եկեղեցին իր դռներն է բացել հավատացյալների առջև 2010 թվականին:  Կառուցման համար օգտագործվել է տեղական սրբատաշ քար (տուֆ կամ բազալտ): Ունի գմբեթավոր սրահի հորինվածք՝ արևելյան կողմում տեղակայված խորանով: Դարբասի Սուրբ Ստեփանոս եկեղեցին վերականգնել է գյուղի հարուստ միջնադարյան հոգևոր ավանդույթները. ըստ պատմական աղբյուրների՝ 15-րդ դարում Դարբասն ունեցել է 7 եկեղեցի:

name: Plutei, Biblioteca Malatestiana (Cesena, Italy)
description:
***Plutei*, Biblioteca Malatestiana (Cesena, Italy)**

The Biblioteca Malatestiana, founded in 1452 by Malatesta Novello, is the oldest civic library in Europe still preserved in its original setting. Its cypress wood reading desks, known as plutei, were designed to hold manuscripts on slanted surfaces, with benches attached for readers. Each book was chained to the desk, ensuring accessibility while protecting the collection.

name: Luigi Stoisa – Dal vecchio al nuovo (1996)
description: L'opera è un monumento urbano fortemente concettuale e materico che esplora la dinamica e il passaggio tra generazioni. È composta da una scomposizione di elementi contrastanti: un blocco di pietra solido e piantato a terra, che simboleggia il passato e il "vecchio", e una struttura a forma di "carriola" di ferro, aperta e ricettiva, che rappresenta il futuro e il "nuovo". Tra i due blocchi si interpone una sfera, l'elemento geometrico che suggerisce il movimento e la trasmissione della conoscenza. Dal monumento cola del bitume, metafora visiva delle esperienze e delle nozioni accumulate nel tempo che vengono infine restituite alla collettività.

This model is inspired by Jake the Dog, one of the most iconic characters from Adventure Time, reimagined as an elder version with a unique stylized look.

 ***Creation Pipeline:***

1. Base Modeling: Autodesk Maya
2. Sculpting: Mudbox
3. Hand Painting & Texturing: Mudbox & Adobe Substance

I focused on giving him a cartoonish yet aged appearance, adding personality and expression while keeping the essence of the original character.

Dzięki siedmiu dostępnym rozmiarom oraz płynnej regulacji kąta nachylenia, zapewniają dostęp do dowolnego poziomu roboczego.
Złożone schody [Modulo 18] mogą być używane jako pomost o zasięgu 4,9 m.
Zastosowanie wysokich, zimnogiętych profili sprawia, że konstrukcja charakteryzuje się wysoką wytrzymałością i nie wymaga dodatkowych podpór ani bortnic.

Construction staircases are universal devices that provide safe movement between floors on construction sites.  
Thanks to seven available sizes and smooth angle adjustment, they allow access to any working level.  
Folded stairs [Modulo 18] can be used as a platform with a reach of 4,9 meters.  
The use of high, cold-formed profiles ensures high durability of the structure, eliminating the need for additional supports or toe boards.

name: Hippopotamus amphibius - MNCN22307
description:
**Description**: The common hippopotamus is a semi-aquatic marvel, with a skull designed to keep its eyes, ears, and nostrils above water while the rest of its massive body remains submerged. As the third-largest land mammal, the hippo's skeletal structure is a masterclass in supporting immense weight both on land and in the buoyant environments of African river systems.

**Specimen**: *Hippopotamus amphibius*  (Linnaeus, 1758)

**Inventory number**: MNCN-22307

**Collection**: Museo Nacional de Ciencias Naturales, Mamíferos. Curator: Ángel Garvía (colecciondemamiferos@mncn.csic.es)

**More about**:

Find more about the MNCN [here](http:mncn.csic.es/en).

Find more about the collection [here](http:mncn.csic.es/es/colecciones/cientificas/mamiferos).

name: Swimmer from Doctor Who
description:
Swimmers were immense transcendental beings which dwelt in the Void between universes. They were so vast that universes burst against their sides like bubbles against a whale. One and the hermit released the Fendahl Predator to prevent Swimmers from being attracted to the universe. (PROSE: The Taking of Planet 5) They were also known as intercreationals. (PROSE: The Book of the War)

The Eighth Doctor considered Swimmers to be among the predators that could eat him while he was drifting through the Time Vortex unprotected. (PROSE: The Shadows of Avalon)

The loa Baron Samedi, his "wife" Maman Brigitte, and Spinning Jenny were Swimmers. According to Homeworld agent Cobden, Swimmers were merely another form of Leviathan that disturbed the "waters of reality" merely by existing. (PROSE: Spinning Jenny)

name: Yoriichi
description:
Yoriichi Tsugikuni. 
For free.
He's rigged,  he's (kind of) emotionally stable, textured, and is defenceless because who has time to model swords?

Problems that may encounter and how to solve them:

1. Why's he black?: It may be the the outlines! Try enabling backface culling in blender.

2. Where are his textures?: If they are not in the file automaticly...FBX files usually come in a ZIP file and you may or may not have to manually assign them... Try also dowloading a different file type. Like USDZ.

3.  I want to animate him but when i deleted all the keyframes he's stuck in a pose? **or** How to get him to T-pose or set him to default pose?: Go to pose mode, select all bones by click and drag or the shortcut A, then after you selected everything click Alt R to reset *rotation*, Alt G to reset *location* and Alt S to reset *scale*.

**He's not for download bc im editing him. I also want to give him animations that you get for free with him.**

Model made by HINDIDUBVERSE. Textures and armature made by me~

name: Kissing Bug (P. chinai ♂) - Loja, Ecuador
description:
This male kissing bug (*Panstrongylus chinai*) was collected in Naranjo Adentro, Loja province, Ecuador and 3D-scanned using [scAnt](https://sketchfab.com/3d-models/scant-open-source-3d-insect-scanner-234556e5bb714c30942f779ca582455e) by [EvoBiomech](https://sketchfab.com/EvoBiomech).

This insect is part of the [Infectious and Tropical Diseases Research Division](https://cisealpuce.edu.ec/en/research/research-groups/476-itd.html) collection at the [CISeAL](https://cisealpuce.edu.ec/en/) (Center for Research on Health in Latin America). This research complex studies tropical diseases in order to mitigate their effects and potentially eradicate them for good.

*Panstrongylus chinai* is a vector of Chagas disease in the south of Ecuador and in the north of Peru.

description: The Temple of Augustus and Rome is an augusteum located in the Altındağ district of Ankara. It is thought to have been built around 25–20 AD. Besides being one of the most important Roman-period ruins in the city, it is also known for the Monumentum Ancyranum. This is an inscription about the works of Augustus, who was considered the first Roman emperor. It is the most complete copy of Res Gestae Divi Augusti that has survived to the present day, as the original in Rome had disappeared.

name: 1998 Mercedes-Benz E55 AMG W210
description:
The 1998 Mercedes-Benz E55 AMG is a landmark car in the history of performance sedans. Before AMG became a mainstream, in-house tuning division, this car represented the pinnacle of the "hand-built" era, where AMG took a standard Mercedes E-Class and transformed it into a brutal, understated super-sedan. It was the ultimate Q-ship—a car with unassuming looks that hid a devastatingly powerful heart.

Performance & Powertrain: The Heart of the Beast
Engine: At its core lies the legendary M113 E55 engine. This is a massive, naturally aspirated 5.4-liter V8. Unlike later AMG engines, this one was hand-built by a single technician (as signified by a plaque on the engine cover), following AMG's "one man, one engine" philosophy.

Power Output: It produced 349 horsepower (260 kW) at 5,500 rpm and a colossal 391 lb-ft (530 Nm) of torque at 3,000 rpm. These figures were staggering for a four-door sedan in the late 1990s.

name: Gremio de Sant Esteve | BARCELONA
description:
Catedral de Barcelona | Gremio de Sant Esteve | BARCELONA

Del gremio de los Esteves se tienen noticias desde el siglo XIII. Los osarios datan de 1647, según indican las propias inscripciones. Además de la capilla de la catedral, el gremio poseía una sede en la calle Freneria que le dio nombre. Esta calle comunica la zona del ábside con la calle Llibreteria. La sede estaba al inicio de la calle más próxima al ábside. Por este motivo, la corporación disfrutaba de un exclusivo privilegio que denotaba su importancia social: una puerta, hoy inexistente, permitía entrar directamente desde la calle a la capilla, que de este modo quedaba comunicada con la casa gremial de Freneria.

name: Vampirical Blight Drone
description:
Every hive needs Drones. The mindless bugs that follow orders and work inside the hive to provide for the Queen. While they are most accustomed to working, they can *and will* defend themselves and the Queen if necessary. They have sharp, elongated legs and pincers, mainly used for transporting meat or other objects throughout the hives.

The Vampirical Blight Drone is a blood collecting *Beetle Rubigenum Drone* that works in Vampiric Blight hives, storing blood and delivering it to the Queen and her eggs. In desperate times, drones will often cannibalize each other to feed the Queen and her eggs.

**Other Things to Note:**  *Vampirical Drones coat the tunnels of their hives with blood to make for a more habitable environment. Biohazard equipment recommended.*

Modeled, retopologized, rigged and animated in Blender. Textured in Quixel Mixer. 
Also see: [Vampirical Blight Queen](https://sketchfab.com/3d-models/vampirical-blight-queen-943c5865b9f94ce48ccea253382c0d77)

name: Great white shark jaw
description:
“Great White Shark jaw” (https://skfb.ly/WsOI) by NHM_Imaging is licensed under CC Attribution-NonCommercial-NoDerivs ([http://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-nc-nd/4.0/]

This is a laser scan of a Great White Shark jaw which was originally reported as coming from an 11 metre-long (36 feet) shark, though subsequent analysis by the Museum estimates it at about 7.5 metres (25 feet) – still a very large fish! The specimen demonstrates the incredible rows of spare teeth that Great Whites have lined up inside their jaw. If a tooth is lost the next one in line just folds up to take its place. The specimen was used for public engagement for many years and has suffered as a result.

name: DAE Diorama - By The Ocean
description:
**Location: The Loften Islands, Norway**

Perched atop a rugged cliff in the Norwegian archipelago, a weathered yellow Rorbu stands as a warm sanctuary against the cold North Sea. It is the golden hour. The low sun casts long, amber shadows through the pine trees, signaling the end of a hard day's work.

On the wooden deck, dinner is served... plates and bottles rest on the table, waiting for the fisherman to sit down. Below, the old fishing boat bobs gently by the dock, its engine finally quiet.

Beside the cabin, the lighthouse glows in the twilight, it is a silent guardian watching over this peaceful slice of life in the north...

name: Whirligear - playground
description:
**The Whirligear Playground**

Tucked between ivy-covered brick walls and old cobblestone paths lies Whirligear Playground—a wondrous place where imagination runs on gears, levers, and a hint of steam. Towering brass towers with winding staircases invite kids to climb up and peer through polished glass scopes.

Spinning wheels, clanking contraptions, and puffing vents bring the whole playground to life. The swings are suspended from copper pipes, squeaking delightfully with every arc. A carousel powered by foot pedals spins children in brass-seated pods shaped like airships and beetles.

There’s even a giant ticking clock face kids can climb, its hands moving just slowly enough to offer a thrilling ride. Whistles blow, chimneys puff, and laughter echoes through metal tubes shaped like dragons.

Every surface gleams with golden bolts and rivets, and even the benches are made of warm wood and riveted iron. It's a world of playful invention—where imagination clicks, clanks, and whirs with wonder.

name: Silverstone Circuit 2024 layout
description:
The Silverstone Circuit is a motor racing circuit in England, near the Northamptonshire villages Silverstone and Whittlebury. It is the home of the British Grand Prix, which it first hosted as the 1948 British Grand Prix. The 1950 British Grand Prix at Silverstone was the first race in the newly created World Championship of Drivers. The race rotated between Silverstone, Aintree and Brands Hatch from 1955 to 1986, but settled permanently at the Silverstone track in 1987. The circuit also hosts the British round of the MotoGP series.

The Silverstone Circuit is on the site of a Royal Air Force bomber station, RAF Silverstone, which was operational between 1943 and 1946. The station was the base for the No. 17 Operational Training Unit. The airfield's three runways, in classic WWII triangle format, lie within the outline of the present track.

name: TheMonk_NFT
description:
At the summit of a mist-shrouded mountain, a lone monk sits in absolute stillness. His figure, quiet and unshaken, seems to exist somewhere between earth and sky. The wind brushes against his worn robe, yet nothing disturbs the calm that radiates from him. His closed eyes do not flee from the world; they embrace it from within.

They say he meditates to hear what the noise of life keeps hidden: a voice not born from thought, but from the soul. And in that deep silence, he uncovers a truth few dare to face—peace is not found by climbing mountains, but by descending into oneself. The mystery surrounding him lies not in the height of the peak, but in the depth of his spirit.

There, in the solitude of the pure air, his presence teaches that whoever masters their mind masters every path; and that the greatest journey is never toward the horizon, but toward the heart.

name: Dante Confronting the Three Beasts
description:
**Dante e le tre fiere** – una scena simbolica dell’Inferno (I, 31-60), qui ricreata in versione 3D.
Il pellegrino, smarrito “in una selva oscura”, viene respinto da tre animali che rappresentano gli ostacoli morali del suo cammino: lonza, leone, lupa, allegorie di **lussuria**, **superbia** e **cupidigia** che gli sbarrano il cammino.

Ed ecco, quasi al cominciar de l’erta,
una **lonza** leggiera e presta molto
che di pel macolato era coverta.

Ed ecco quasi al cominciar dell’erta
mi si mostrò un **leone**, che parea
che contra me venisse con la testa alta.

Ed una **lupa**… che di tutte brame
sembrava carca ne la sua magrezza:
e molte genti fé già viver grame.

La scena richiama il momento in cui Dante capisce che non può salvarsi da solo, preludio all’arrivo di Virgilio. Dante comprende che da solo non può salvarsi, preludio all’arrivo di Virgilio.

A cura di prof. Alessio Langella ITI via Degli Orti di Alghero

name: Stramonita Haemastoma, Campa Torres
description:
La Stramonita haemastoma o Thais haemastoma es un molusco de la familia de Muricidae. Tiene la característica especial de soltar un líquido de color púrpura (azul violáceo). Este color era utilizado en la Antigüedad e indicaba poder. 
La presencia en los concheros de la Campa Torres, en Gijón, Asturias, parece indicar la producción a nivel doméstico de este tipo de tinte usado para aplicar en los tejidos y difundida desde tiempos fenicios.
Fotogrametría 3D de una de las piezas halladas en las excavaciones del yacimiento

name: XYZ | Draft Punk | Secondary forms
description:
**Homework #4 | Variations of the object and painting**

> 1 "Prototype" - First, I created a basic design of a regular brick house with a tower. It served as a prototype for all subsequent versions.
> 
2 "Family" - a cozy house with warm shades of brown, red, and light green create an atmosphere of home comfort.
> 
3 "Crazy" - the house is on fire, with flames engulfing the walls and roof, and a canister of gasoline can be seen in the nearby bushes. The color palette combines the cold blue and white tones of the landscape with the aggressive orange, red, and black hues of the flames.
> 
4 "Abandoned" - an old, dilapidated house. The muted tones of gray and faded red brick emphasize the desolation.
> 
5 "Special Purpose" is an amusement house with a slide instead of a tower. Its dynamic silhouette and eye-catching paintwork (rich red, blue, and yellow with neon accents) create a festive atmosphere.

**This work was done as part of the XYZ Draft Punk course**

name: Hirudinaria granulosa – Nervous System
description:
This 3D model shows the nervous system of the Indian cattle leech (Hirudinaria granulosa), a member of Phylum Annelida. The system is simple, ladder-like, and segmentally organized, adapted for coordinated movement and sensory response.

It consists of a pair of anterior cerebral ganglia (brain) connected to a double ventral nerve cord. Along the nerve cord, a series of segmental ganglia are present, each controlling specific body segments.

The leech also has sensory receptors for detecting touch, vibrations, and environmental changes.

This model is useful for studying annelid neuroanatomy, segmental organization, and basic nervous coordination.

description:
Este modelo 3D apresenta o estudo preliminar do novo layout do **Apartamento 305**, localizado em Águas Claras, em Brasília/DF.

O projeto foi desenvolvido pela **Maculanz – Arquitetura Esportiva**, especializada em soluções arquitetônicas voltadas ao universo fitness e esportivo.

A proposta contempla:
- A adição do piso vinílico em todo o apartamento, exceto em áreas molhadas (banheiros e cozinha); 
- Adição de planejados, buscando otimizar a circulação, melhorar a experiência dos usuários e valorizar o espaço existente.

⚠️* Observação*: Este modelo representa uma versão conceitual ainda em fase de criação, podendo sofrer alterações até a definição final do projeto.

name: ツキヨミガイ / Glossocardia obesa
description:
殻は箱型、殻頂は前傾し、低く、コウボネガイ類のように強く巻き込まれない。沖縄以南、フィリピン、インドネシア、ニューカレドニア。水深5～60ｍの貝殻混じり礫底。

The shell is box-shaped, with a low, forward-sloping apex that is not strongly coiled like that of the Glossidae genus. Found south of Okinawa, as well as in the Philippines, Indonesia, and New Caledonia. Found on gravel bottoms mixed with shells at depths of 5–60 m.

和名：ツキヨミガイ

英名：Glossocardia obesa

学名：Glossocardia obesa (Reeve, 1843)　フナガタガイ科　Trapezidae

殻長：4.8㎝

参考文献：「日本近海産貝類図鑑」【第二版】奥谷喬司 編著 東海大学出版部（2017年1月）

References：Illustrated Guide to Shellfish of Japanese Coastal Waters [Second Edition] Edited by Takashi Okutani Tokai University Press (January 2017)

name: OPH2028  Carcharodontosaurid maxilla
description:
# Description:
OPH2028a consists in a partial left maxilla belonging to a large carcharodontosaurid from the Kem Kem Compound Assemblage. This specimen contributes to ongoing research on the diversity and evolutionary relationships of North African theropods.

* **Locality and horizon:** Kem Kem Beds, Morocco – Cenomanian, Late Cretaceous
* **Institution:** OPHIS Museo Paleontologico e Centro Erpetologico
* **Reference:** [Paterna A. and Cau A. (2022).](https://l1nq.com/OaOCs)


For further details and access to the 3D model, please visit [OPHIS Museo Paleontologico](https://ophis.info ), or send an e-mail to info@ophis.info

* 3D model and Scan: [Simone Saccomandi](https://sketchfab.com/SimoneSaccomandi)
* Supervision: [Mario Falasca](https://sketchfab.com/marfal)

name: Proteção de Torno com Grade de Segurança
description: Projeto de proteção para torno mecânico, constituído por estrutura de grade de segurança instalada ao redor da máquina, conforme configuração apresentada, com a finalidade de impedir o acesso involuntário às zonas de perigo durante a operação. A proteção será projetada considerando os riscos associados às partes móveis e rotativas, incluindo mandril, eixo, transmissão, ferramenta, peça em usinagem e possíveis projeções de materiais. O projeto será desenvolvido de acordo com os requisitos aplicáveis da NR-12, ABNT NBR ISO 12100, ABNT NBR ISO 13857 e ABNT NBR ISO 14120, considerando distâncias de segurança, resistência mecânica, fixação, estabilidade e condições de acesso para operação, limpeza, inspeção e manutenção. Quando houver acesso por portas ou portinholas, serão avaliados dispositivos de segurança e intertravamento aplicáveis. Serão elaborados desenhos técnicos, detalhes construtivos, especificações dos materiais e orientações para fabricação e instalação da proteção.

description:
This medieval-inspired manor features a complex architectural layout, including a soaring central turret with a slate-blue spire, timber-framed gables, and a charming covered bridge connecting the main wings.

The manor sits atop a circular mossy plinth, complete with a stone staircase, flourishing flower beds, and a backyard well. Warm light glows from the interior windows, suggesting a lived-in, magical atmosphere perfect for fantasy RPG environments or isometric game art.

Style: Stylized Voxel Art, 3D Pixel Art.

Architecture: Tudor-style timber framing, conical towers, and chimney detailing.

name: Pozdně románský kapitál, Muzeum Cheb
description:
**CZ** Pozdně románský kapitál (13. století) zdobený lidskými postavami, původně z kostela sv. Mikuláše v Chebu (Eger), vystavený v Muzeu Cheb. Jedná se o jeden z mála dochovaných pozůstatků původní stavby, která byla postavena v době, kdy město spadalo pod vládu rodu Švábského, a to až do roku 1265, kdy bylo dobyto Otakarem II.

**ESP** Capitel  tardorrománico (s. XIII) decorado con figuras humanas originario de la iglesia de San Nicolás de Cheb (Eger), expuesto en el Muzeum Cheb. Es uno de los pocos restos del edificio original, construído cuando la ciudad estaba bajo el dominio de la casa de Suabia hasta 1265, cuando fue conquistada por Ottokar II.

**ENG** A late Romanesque capital (13th century) decorated with human figures, originally from the Church of St Nicholas in Cheb (Eger), now on display at the Muzeum Cheb. It is one of the few remaining parts of the original building, which was constructed whilst the town was under the rule of the House of Swabia until 1265, when it was conquered by Ottokar II.

name: Circuit de Nevers Magny-Cours 2019 layout
description:
The Circuit de Nevers Magny-Cours is a 4.411 km (2.741 mi) motor racing circuit located in central France, near the towns of Magny-Cours and Nevers, some 250 km (160 mi) from Paris and 240 km (150 mi) from Lyon.

It staged the Formula One French Grand Prix from 1991 (succeeding Circuit Paul Ricard) to 2008, and the 24-hour Bol d'Or motorcycle endurance events from 2000 to 2014 (succeeded by Circuit Paul Ricard). It hosted the French motorcycle Grand Prix in 1992, and the Superbike World Championship in 1991 and annually since 2003.

Magny-Cours has hosted several additional international championships, like the World Sportscar Championship, World Touring Car Championship, FIA GT Championship, World Series by Renault and Formula 3 Euroseries. Also, the FFSA GT Championship has visited the circuit since 1997.

![](https://i.pinimg.com/1200x/97/73/c2/9773c2efb9ba61152088f966645cc7d8.jpg)

name: KIRIK KIRIK SENJA (CHESTNUT-HEADED BEE-EATER)
description:
Kirik-kirik senja merupakan burung ramping berukuran sedang dengan panjang tubuh sekitar 18–20 cm. Ciri khasnya terletak pada kepala dan tengkuk berwarna cokelat kastanye, menyerupai rona cahaya senja. Garis hitam tipis membentang dari pangkal paruh melalui mata, kontras dengan dagu kuning cerah dan tenggorokan biru muda yang lembut.

Bagian punggung dan sayap atas berwarna hijau zamrud berkilau, sedangkan perut hingga tunggir tampak biru kehijauan. Paruhnya hitam, panjang, dan melengkung ke bawah, proporsional dengan wajah berwarna kastanye dan mata merah tua yang tajam.

Ekor kirik-kirik senja tidak memiliki dua bulu tengah yang menjulur panjang, melainkan berujung rata dengan gradasi hijau keabu-abuan di bagian luar. Kakinya kecil, ramping, dan berwarna hitam keabu-abuan, berfungsi untuk mencengkeram ranting halus saat bertengger. Saat terbang, burung ini tampak anggun dengan sayap runcing dan pola warna yang kontras di bawah sinar matahari.

name: Green-banded urania (sunset) moth
description:
Urania leilus, the green-banded urania, is a day-flying moth of the family Uraniidae. The species was first described by Carl Linnaeus in his 1758 10th edition of Systema Naturae. It is found in tropical South America east of the Andes, especially in the Amazon rainforest. Its range includes Suriname, Guyana, French Guiana, eastern Colombia, Venezuela, eastern Ecuador, Brazil, northern Bolivia, eastern Peru, as well as the island of Trinidad. It has been recorded as a vagrant to the central and northern Lesser Antilles, such as St. Kitts, Barbados and Dominica. Their preferred habitat consists of riverbanks, in primary and secondary rainforest, at elevations between sea level and about 800 m (2,600 ft).

Based of this model: https://sketchfab.com/3d-models/madagascan-sunset-moth-5eb521c24f1c4aa6ad052ee4682cbd13

name: Etruscan seal (left femur)
description:
3D scan of the left femur of the Etruscan seal (*Pliophoca etrusca*).

The fossil skeleton of *Pliophoca etrusca*, collected in1900 by Antonio di Paco from the upper Pliocene (Piacenzian) clays of Casa Nuova locality, near Orciano Pisano (Tuscany, Pisa province, Italy) is the best preserved and most complete fossil seal of the northern hemysphere and holotype of the fossil species *Pliophoca etrusca*.
This specimen was first described in detail and referred to the extant Mediterranean monk seal *Monachus albiventer* (=*Monachus monachus*) by Ugolini (1902); later on Tavani (1941) redescribed this specimen and assigned it to the new genus and species of monachine seals *Pliophoca etrusca*. It was finally redescribed by Berta et al. (2015).

Specimen: *Pliophoca etrusca* Tavani, 1941

Inventory number: I13993

Collection: Natural History Museum University of Pisa

Find out more about the Museum at [https://www.msn.unipi.it/it/](http://)

name: Two-floor Expandable Container House
description:

name: Fortress Draegonhold - castle
description:
Fortress Draegonhold looms on the craggy peaks of the Draegon Mountains, a majestic stronghold built during the Age of Storms. Modeled after the strategic design of Edinburgh Castle, it was constructed in the 11th century by the legendary warrior-king Tormak the Thunderlord. The fortress was designed to withstand the fury of both human and mythical foes, standing as the last line of defense for the Draegon Kingdom.

The fortress is renowned for its imposing black stone walls and fortified gates, reinforced with iron and steel from the kingdom’s mines. It has withstood countless sieges, including a famous battle against the Stormrider Horde, where it held against overwhelming forces for years. The castle’s Grand Keep houses the Scepter of Storms, a relic said to command the forces of nature itself.

Though often surrounded by swirling storms, Draegonhold remains a symbol of the kingdom’s unwavering strength, its legends passed down through generations.

name: Registro antiguo de Sevilla
description:
Es una tapa histórica de registro municipal, típica de Sevilla y su área metropolitana.

NO8DO: El símbolo oficial del Ayuntamiento de Sevilla.
AS: Relativo a Alcantarillado y Saneamiento.
MACEDA: Fundición que fabricaba piezas y elementos para instalaciones e infraestructuras.
CAMAS: Municipio vecino donde se ubicaba la empresa.

Era habitual que ciertos registros del saneamiento o servicios municipales se colocaran en la pared exterior, especialmente en:
-Ventilación de conducciones.
-Acceso a un punto de unión entre red municipal y bajantes antiguas.
-Paso de canalizaciones por fachada en edificios históricos.

name: Dwór w Krynicach - wirtualna rekonstrukcja 3D
description:
Model 3D przedstawia rekonstrukcję wirtualną dawnego założenia dworskiego w Krynicach. 
Został przygotowany w ramach pracy magisterskiej na kierunku Geoinformatyka na Uniwersytecie Marii Curie-Skłodowskiej w Lublinie.
Rekonstrukcja bryły oraz aktualnego stanu obiektu powstała na bazie wieloźródłowych danych – historycznej dokumentacji konserwatorskiej (kart ewidencyjnych oraz inwentaryzacji z 1976 r.), fotografii archiwalnych, a także współczesnych pomiarów fotogrametrycznych i skaningu laserowego. Aktualnie w rzeczywistości, obiekt ten jest w stanie trwałej ruiny, zachowały sie jedynie trzy ściany zewnętrzne i fragmenty ścian wewnętrznych.

Autorka: Marta Żuber
Promotor: prof. dr hab. Waldemar Kociuba
Uczelnia: UMCS w Lublinie, Wydział Nauk o Ziemi i Gospodarki Przestrzennej

name: Green monkey
description:
3D scan of a skeleton of green monkey (*Chlorocebus sabaeus*). 

The green monkey is an Old World monkey which lives in in West Africa from Senegal and the Gambia to the Volta River in a wide range of wooded habitats, ranging from very dry Sahel woodland to the edge of rainforests. It is also commonly seen in coastal regions, where known to feed on seashore foods such as crabs. It also feeds on a wide variety of other foods, including fruits and invertebrates. Males typically being slightly larger than females measuring between 42 and 60 cm while the females between 30 and 49,5 cm.


Specimen: green monkey, *Chlorocebus sabaeus* (Linnaeus, 1766)

Inventory number: C 1724

Collection: Natural History Museum University of Pisa 

Find out more about the Museum at https://www.msn.unipi.it/it/

Scanned and edited by Simone Farina

description: These enemies don't show up until very late in your adventure. However, once they do, they prove to be formidable opponents. The Desbrachian is typically dormant, but once awakened, it uses its teleportation ability to confuse you before it attacks. It relies heavily on its close-quarters attacks; it swipes at you with its claws, picks you up, and then slams you onto the ground. If it manages to get its claws on you immediately after you bounce off the ground, it can enter into the attack cycle almost immediately, creating an extremely deadly attack combo. Keep the Desbrachian at bay with Charge Beam blasts and hit it with missiles while it's at a distance. If it changes color to a dark red, increase the frequency of your attacks to make it take a knee. When it does, rush in for a Lethal Strike.

Termoizolație Superioară: Permite integrarea facilă a sistemelor de izolație moderne pentru noul spațiu creat.

name: Mercedes-Benz CLK GTR
description:
The Mercedes-Benz CLK GTR is a sports car and racing car produced by Mercedes-AMG, a performance brand of Mercedes-Benz. Created specifically for the new FIA GT Championship in 1997, the CLK GTR was designed primarily as a race car, with the road-going production models (homologation specials) created later to meet racing regulations.

ollowing the demise of the Deutsche Tourenwagen Meisterschaft (DTM)/International Touring Car Championship (ITC) at the end of 1996, Mercedes-Benz needed a new top-tier motorsport program. The newly formed FIA GT Championship provided the perfect opportunity.

Mercedes-AMG developed the CLK GTR from first drawings to a finished race car in a record time of just 128 days. To speed up development, AMG secretly purchased a discarded McLaren F1 GTR chassis to use as a testbed for aerodynamics and body panels.

name: French Light Cavalry Saber M1822 - Low Poly
description:
This is the Sabre de Cavalerie legere modèle 1822. It was a standard issue cavalry saber for light cavalry troops such as the hussars for example. During the mid victorian era you would see the start of the debate between the superiority of curved versus straight blades. Curved blades were more appropriate for slashing and cutting, whereas straight swords were superior at stabbing. In the end you would see something in between curved and straight. This is one of the last sabers that still had a bigger curve to it. It stayed with the French army for a large part of the 19th century. 

Excellent mesh for a soldier or as a decorational piece or scene prop. 

Tris: 3,034
Textures: 2K

The face is formally modelled, featuring large eyes, an aquiline nose, and a small mouth with well-defined lips. The fragment is broken cleanly at the neck. Stylistically, the head has been dated to the Thirteenth Dynasty (c. 1773–1650 BC) of the Middle Kingdom.

Purchased by Sir Henry Wellcome in 1906 from the collection of Robert de Rustafjaell (lot 219). On long-term loan to the Egypt Centre since 1971 as part of the dispersal of the Wellcome collection.

name: Oriskany Corduroy Road
description: Hidden on the battlefield of Oriskany, NY in the close woods, the British Loyalists and their Native allies silently waited for the Patriots to enter the ravine on the morning of August 6, 1777. It was muggy and the mosquitos were swarming. Sir John Johnson’s Loyalist regiment took up position on the eastern end of the ravine to meet the Patriots head on, while Joseph Brant’s Mohawks and Colonel John Butler’s Rangers encircled it. The Mohawks were to wait until the mile-long column of militia were deep into the ravine where the corduroy road, made of logs laid side-by-side over marshy ground, was found. Once the Patriots were bottled up at the end, the Native warriors would attack the rear, preventing the militia’s escape.

name: Burgzand Noord 9, Waddenzee (Netherlands)
description: In 2021 and 2023, the Dutch Cultural Heritage Agency fully excavated one of the shipwrecks in the protected area of Burgzand Noord, Waddenzee. The remains of this shipwreck (which has the number 9) are from an approximate 35m long wooden sailing vessel which was probably made around 1640. This ships was a Dutch armed trading vessel that made trading runs in the Baltic as in the Mediterranean. The shipwreck lays at a depth of 9 to 11 m (depending the tide). The strong currents and poor visibility in the Waddenzee makes the creation of a good 3D model a challenging activity. The entire shipwreck was made out of 17 different sections/batches which can be noticed in the colour differences. The original model has 60k images and consists of over 130 million faces.
