name: Wooden shipwreck covered by railway rails
description:
Discovered in 2024 during a sonar survey in the North Sea north of Ameland, this site was dive-investigated in 2025.
The wreck consists of wooden ship remains, largely covered by a massive cargo of railway rails. 
Preserved wooden structures were identified beneath the rails.
The diving investigation was conducted by members of the Stichting Maritieme Archeologie, within the 13 Provinces Programme of the RCE (Rijksdienst voor het Cultureel Erfgoed).

The Dutch toponym of the wreck is “Spoorstavenwrak”. It is located 2 nautical miles north of the island of Ameland.

name: Acid Gun Rework
description:
"A party without acid? Waste of money."

My rework of the Acid Gun from Will Rock for Serious Sam Fusion.


The Acid Gun uses a 0.3 L acid tank, feed pump and 40 mm plunger pump. The feed pump keeps the plunger supplied, while its return stroke draws in roughly 50–60 mL of acid — about five full shots per tank.

Pull the trigger and a BLDC motor drives the plunger through dual high-strength timing belts and a 10:1 gearbox. The firing stroke forces acid through the reinforced pressure line at peaks of around 20 bar / 290 psi, putting roughly 2.5 kN of load on the plunger. The sci-fi belts are assumed to be about 5× stronger than comparable industrial belts. A 300 psi gauge monitors system pressure.

Mod for Serious Sam Fusion:
https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3790144629

name: 𝖍𝖔𝖑𝖔𝖒𝖊𝖙𝖆𝖇𝖔𝖑𝖔𝖚𝖘
description:
Pupation is a stage in the life of an insect where it transforms from larva into an imago. One creature enters the cocoon, and a radically different one emerges from it. Such drastic change in the midst of life. Big risk that comes with being immobilised, slowly dissolved and rematerialised again. How does it feel? Do the memories and experiences of past life remain in the new body? Is the insect after moulting even the same as the one it was before? To me, this dilemma resembles the one of the ship of Theseus: a vessel which after leaving the port has been fixed and modified on its journey, until upon arriving at its destination none of the original parts remained, begging the question, has it remained the same thing or is it something new?</br>

name: HUACALES - #####
description:
Proyecto de Realidad Aumentada – Huacales 3D

En esta actividad se desarrollaron modelos 3D de huacales aplicando diferentes técnicas de modelado, texturizado, materiales e iluminación. Se utilizaron UV Maps para desenvolver la geometría y aplicar texturas; Mesh Images como apoyo para trabajar imágenes sobre los modelos; escaneo 3D para obtener objetos a partir de referencias reales; Inteligencia Artificial para generar recursos visuales; y Materialize para crear mapas de materiales como Normal, Height y Roughness. También se incorporaron imágenes HDRI para generar iluminación y ambientes más realistas, además de animaciones para dar movimiento a los modelos y complementar la experiencia de Realidad Aumentada.

El proyecto permitió experimentar con diferentes herramientas y procesos de creación 3D, integrando modelado, texturizado, materiales, iluminación y animación.

name: Πρόπλασμα Ρινικής  Κοιλότητας και Κρανίου
description:
Το αντικείμενο αυτό αποτελεί το συμπληρωματικό, άνω τμήμα της ανατομικής τομής της κεφαλής που καταγράφηκε προηγουμένως. Τοποθετημένο πάνω στην ίδια χαρακτηριστική γκρι βάση, το μοντέλο αυτό εστιάζει στην οστική δομή του κρανίου και στο ανώτερο αναπνευστικό σύστημα.

Διακρίνεται ξεκάθαρα η κατατομή της μύτης, η ρινική κοιλότητα και ο σκληρός ουρανίσκος. Το πιο εντυπωσιακό και περίτεχνο στοιχείο της κατασκευής είναι η αναπαράσταση του σπογγώδους οστού του κρανίου (στο αριστερό τμήμα του μοντέλου). Η πορώδης υφή του οστού και τα κολπώματα έχουν αποδοθεί με εκπληκτική γλυπτική λεπτομέρεια, βαμμένα σε υποκίτρινες αποχρώσεις. Όπως και στο προηγούμενο τμήμα, διακρίνονται ανεπαίσθητα μικροί αριθμοί πάνω στις δομές, οι οποίοι αντιστοιχούσαν στο χαμένο πλέον υπόμνημα του εκθέματος.

name: Orgues volcaniques rhyolitiques
description:
**Description & informations :** orgues volcaniques rhyolitiques. Cette structure en orgue est due à la rétractation de la lave rhyolitique lors de son refroidissement. Les fentes de rétractation qui se forment présentent une section idéalement hexagonale. Les orgues sont disposés perpendiculairement à la surface de refroidissement. Les orgues sont ici quasi-horizontaux. L'arrière des orgues a été affectée par le phénomène de haloclastie (altération-érosion due aux embruns) qui donne un aspect carié à la roche.

**Dimensions **: 2 x 1,7 m environ.

**Âge :** Permien.

**Localité :** La batterie des lions à Saint Raphaël (Var, France).
Coordonnées GPS : 43.409291, 6.783988

**Méthode **: Photoscan 3D au lidar de l’iPad pro scanné avec le logiciel Scaniverse.

**Réalisation :** École Nationale Supérieure de Géologie de Nancy - Contributeur : Yann Hautevelle - Date : 29/05/2024.

name: Woodpath - Dot3d Iphone Scan
description:
Compiled from a Dot3d Scan with an Iphone.
During scanning the Nerf feature was enabled and collected images along with the TOF depth scan of Dot3d. The Pointcloud and the images had been imported to RealityScan and merged. Where the pointcloud had been used to create the mesh, the images was used to create the texture. We developed a sepcial application that transforms the images Coordinates collected during scanning into a format that realityscan can interpret, so there is no need to use markers to align both sets.

name: Lars Magnus Ericsson- Phone
description:
Lars Magnus Ericsson ,born May 5, 1846, on the farm of Nordtomta in the village of Vergebols in Värmland; December 17, 1926 in Botkyrka, Stockholm County) is a Swedish inventor, known as the founder of the telecommunications company Ericsson .
Ericsson grew up in the small town of Vegerbol, between Karlstad and Arvika. Orphaned by his father at the age of 11, he had to work sometimes as a railway worker, sometimes as a miner, in Sweden and Norway. In 1867 he moved to Stockholm and was hired by the telegraph manufacturer Öller & Cie. Six years later, he received a scholarship to continue his training abroad. He studied in Switzerland then in Germany, where he also worked for Siemens & Halske.
Lars Magnus Ericsson died in 1926 and was buried in Botkyrka, south of Stockholm. In accordance with his last wishes, his tomb is free of epitaph.

name: Gorilla Cranium Male
description:
Male gorilla cranium edited to be 3D printable. Original model (Specimen USNM585487) was made available by the [Smithsonian](https://3d.si.edu/object/3d/gorilla-gorilla-gorilla-cranium:40b67fa6-41de-40d5-894e-db46223832f7) under CC0 license.

[This video](https://youtu.be/hm6AB-PY064) shows the tools I use to edit CT/microCT models to make them more easily printable: removing internal structures, filling holes and thin areas, smoothing rough spots. This cranium is the final version that I printed using BambuSlicer to cut it into 2 parts and add connectors (it's very big!). You can see from my 3D print that there was a thin wall in the right orbit--I have thickened that wall for this STL so it should not print with a hole there.
![slicerview](https://i.imgur.com/fp5gZcl.jpg)
![3d print](https://i.imgur.com/gfzuebT.jpg)

name: big cage in CS-II
description:
You might imagine a solid with equal edges whose 12 faces are regular pentagons and 4 faces are regular hexagons. On the right, we demonstrate—using regular polygons—that this is impossible. Regular hexagons surrounded by regular pentagons are situated in  4 corners of a cube.  When we make them closer to each other, the pentagons won't align! 

On the left is an actual cage. Its faces are not flat, and the angles differ slightly from the ideal 120 and 108 degrees.

In the foreground is a diagram showing the connections between all 28 water molecules.

The cage can be occupied by a single propane molecule C3H8, one isobutane molecule (CH3)3CH, two hydrogen sulfide molecules H2S, or as many as four hydrogen molecules.

name: Modelo Perezoso
description:
Explora el pasado en 3D: El Cráneo del Perezoso Fósil.

¿Sabías que hace miles de años, la región estaba habitada por perezosos terrestres gigantes? A diferencia de los perezosos arborícolas que conocemos hoy, estos increíbles mamíferos caminaban sobre la tierra y tenían un tamaño sorprendente.

En este modelo 3D puedes explorar al detalle la anatomía de su cráneo. Observa la forma de su mandíbula y la disposición de sus dientes, los cuales estaban perfectamente adaptados para triturar la dura vegetación de la época.

Este modelo interactivo ha sido digitalizado y optimizado como parte integral del proyecto de puesta en valor del Museo de la Universidad Nacional de La Rioja (UNLaR). Nuestro objetivo es democratizar el acceso a la ciencia y acercar el invaluable patrimonio paleontológico y cultural a toda la comunidad a través de las nuevas tecnologías.

name: bromine clathrate - part 2
description:
A very interesting structure. Below and in the comments I describe the principles underlying its formation.

1. Why, after the first cage is formed, does the next one attach to its hexagonal face?
Because for the second cage, six edges are already in place—unlike the situation with the side faces, where there are only five.

2. Why don't 5¹²-type cages form on the sides of the resulting stack?
Because they don't fit. While they are flexible, they cannot accommodate such a large molecule inside. Attaching in such a location takes too long. Forming a 5¹²6²-type cage is easier and faster.

3. We have identified two different sites to be filled. To form a new face, the higher site requires three edges, whereas the lower one requires only two. Consequently, the lower site is selected.

4. The structure grows upwards and downwards. Additional stacks are added.

5. These empty spaces can only be filled by 5¹²-type cages.

For the  next steps look into the comments.

Understanding these molecular signals helps in developing treatments for osteoporosis.

In this model, I recreated it based on drawings published online by the Russian Ministry of Defense. The tank is painted in two colors: the base color and the tracks. A texture has also been applied to the tracks.

description:
La construcción de la Iglesia de San Francisco data de 1537, atribuyéndose su fundación a Fray Martín de Valencia. El conjunto arquitectónico tiene un importante valor histórico, por constituir uno de los cuatro primeros monasterios construidos en el continente americano. Destaca el lujoso artesonado o alfarje de la nave mayor de la iglesia, que es uno de los escasos exponentes del arte mudéjar en América, por lo que se le considera una de las joyas del arte colonial. La talla se atribuye al carpintero sevillano López de Arana, quien la ejecutó en el siglo XVIII. Destaca que en este lugar se encuentra el primer púlpito de América.
Referencia: https://mediateca.inah.gob.mx

El Conjunto Conventual Franciscano y Catedralicio de Nuestra Señora de la Asunción fue incorporado a la declaratoria de los “Primeros monasterios del siglo XVI en las laderas del Popocatépetl”, Patrimonio Mundial de la UNESCO.

name: La Cabrera Church, Sigüenza, Spain
description:
**Description**: The medieval church of La Cabrera (Sigüenza, Spain) was built in the Middle Ages (12th/13th century) next to the Dulce River. This is a simple but beautiful example of the rural Romanesque style that emerged after the Christian conquest of these lands in the 12th century. Its main interest lies in the few modifications it has undergone ever since its construction, especially in the apse. 

**Methodology**: 3D model made in Reality Capture using 111 Leica RTC360 scan positions, 3483 terrestrial-based images, and 1727 drone-based images. Additional processing completed in Geomagic Wrap and Meshlab.

**Acknowledgment**: We want to thank the Diocesan Delegation of Cultural Heritage of Guadalajara, especially its cultural delegate Mr. Miguel Ángel Ortega Canales, for the facilities they have given us and for the interest they have shown in the project.

name: Maddoxtown: Font (re-upload)
description:
Mediaeval font in Maddoxtown (aka Maddockstown) graveyard. Had been found broken in the 19th century, repaired by Tom McDonald in the 1950s, adding central pedestal, pillars and half of the base. The break should be visible in the model. Believed to date from 13th century. Features two carved heads and two carved, now headless birds, barely visible now due to acid rain.
Similar in style to the [one at St. Canice's Cathedral](https://skfb.ly/p7ZBz), St. Francis' Abbey (not accessible to public), the one originally from St. Mary's Church in Kilkenny, now in Cashel (only accessible during service times or by special appointment) and one at Goresbridge Protestant Church (access as before).

Literature listed on [Wikidata](https://www.wikidata.org/wiki/Q130223972). 

SMR no.: KK020-045003-

Made in KiriEngine from 265 images

EDIT (2026-09-07): Compare also to [this Kildare example](https://skfb.ly/pNwWU) which is even more elaborate than the St Canice's one. Thanks to https://sketchfab.com/Kildare_Heritage.

name: Zwingen, Schloss Ramstein
description:
Das Zwingener Schloss ist eine Gründung der Freiherren von Ramstein. Die Geschichte des Schlosses beginnt 1240. Damals wurde der Turm in der Höhe bis zur heutigen Dachterrasse errichtet. Ein Jahr später wurde östlich des Turms ein mächtiger Annexbau mit ebenerdigem, original erhaltenem Spitzbogentor errichtet. Gleichzeitig mit dem Bau der südlichen Beringmauer wurde ein Wohntrakt (Palas?) errichtet. Erst im 16. Jahrhundert erfuhr die Anlage grössere Veränderungen: Wohl zwischen 1572 und 1577 wurde der Innenhof beidseits des Turmes weiter überbaut und auf ein bis zu 1,7 Meter höheres Niveau angehoben. Nach der vollständigen Überbauung des Innenhofes erhöhte man den gesamten Gebäudekomplex um ein Stockwerk und errichtete darüber ein einziges Dach: Aus der Burg war eine «Residenz» geworden, deren Erscheinungsbild sich in der Folge nur noch wenig änderte.

Weitere Informationen: https://www.archaeologie.bl.ch/entdecken/fundstelle/131/eine-erfolglose-stadtgruendung/

3D-Modell: Joe Rohrer, Luzern

name: Moai
description:
A moai, one of the famed, giant stone statues of human figures on Easter Island. Depicted as a gray stone carving of a stylized human head with a prominent brow and nose, most often facing left.

Sometimes used for various idiosyncratic purposes, such as conveying a stoic, deadpan, or silly expression.

Its official Unicode name of Moyai and inclusion in early Japanese emoji sets, such as from au by KDDI, suggest the emoji may represent the Moyai Statue near Shibuya Station in Tokyo, Japan; previous designs from Google and Microsoft resemble the Tokyo statue. Other Tokyo landmarks are represented in 🗼 Tokyo Tower and, formerly, Shibuya 109.

Moai was approved as part of Unicode 6.0 in 2010 under the name "Moyai" and added to Emoji 1.0 in 2015.
